## Featured Projects

### Duff Intelligence with MCP
- **Summary:** AI revenue intelligence copilot for sports venue owners that uses Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations to provide business insights and decision support.
- **Technologies:** AI, MCP, Next.js, Kotlin
- **Website:** https://duffpadel.com/

### Extra Mile Valley: Interactive Learning Gamification
- **Summary:** Web-based gamification platform that helps employees learn and internalize company values through interactive gameplay.
- **Technologies:** Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Java, Spring Boot

### Forgr: Online Store Builder
- **Summary:** Direct-selling commerce platform enabling brands to launch independent online stores, own customer relationships, and avoid marketplace commissions.
- **Technologies:** Next.js, Kotlin, Commerce, QRIS
- **Status:** Coming Soon

### Patchmentation: A Python Library for Patch Augmentation
- **Summary:** Python library implementing patch augmentation, a computer vision data augmentation technique that synthesizes training images by combining objects from multiple images into different backgrounds.
- **Technologies:** Python, Computer Vision, Data Augmentation
- **PyPI:** https://pypi.org/project/patchmentation/

### DeepFaceDrawing: Deep Generation of Face Images from Sketches
- **Summary:** End-to-end implementation of DeepFaceDrawing featuring a two-stage training pipeline, CLI inference, Docker deployment, and web interface for generating face images from sketches.
- **Technologies:** Python, Computer Vision, Generative AI
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/Xu-Justin/DeepFaceDrawing

### Grayscale Face Image Colorization
- **Summary:** Generative AI model that transforms grayscale face images into realistic full-color portraits.
- **Technologies:** Python, Computer Vision, Generative AI
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/Xu-Justin/DeepFaceDrawing

### FiftyOne Embeddings Visualization
- **Summary:** Interactive dashboard for exploring computer vision embeddings and analyzing image similarity using FiftyOne and Plotly Dash.
- **Technologies:** Python, FiftyOne, Plotly Dash
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/Xu-Justin/fiftyone-plotly-dash

### Person Face Dataset
- **Summary:** Public dataset containing 10,000 AI-generated human face images created with ThisPersonDoesNotExist.
- **Technologies:** Kaggle, Dataset, Computer Vision
- **Kaggle:** https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/almightyj/person-face-dataset-thispersondoesnotexist

### Person Face Sketches Dataset
- **Summary:** Public dataset containing over 21,000 paired face photographs and sketch images for computer vision research.
- **Technologies:** Kaggle, Dataset, Computer Vision
- **Kaggle:** https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/almightyj/person-face-sketches
